rsi-europe.note: €29.5m award is joint with Odin Defence and no recipient allocation established. €50m factory spending is capex.

saab.note: Four 2025 notes and two 2021 credit facilities verified. Facility sizes and principal denominations do not establish net cash proceeds. Historical note and facility chronology remains incomplete.
